title: SheepBeSheep
body:
Sheep Being Sheep

This is a plugin fully inspired by `osherdvir.` so SO to him.

It's quite simple:
You summon sheep (or ship) and punch it like a ball in the air.
Because sheep is cool, it can not die. To make it die, you put it in ship (boat) and hit it. Not nice to do that but I can't stop you :(
